hook: Share market wala [[moving average]], ab SQL mein

slides.title: Moving avg [[kyun]]?
points: Last kuch din ka avg → **smooth line** ✓
slides.note: Stock charts ki **50-day line** yahi hai 📈

slides.title: [[Sliding]] window
points: Agli row pe window **aage khisakti** hai
slides.note: Train ki khidki: **naya scene aata, purana jaata** 🚆

slides.title: [[ROWS BETWEEN]]
slides.code:
SELECT month, amount,
  AVG(amount) OVER (
    ORDER BY month_no
    ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING
      AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS moving_avg
FROM sales;

slides.title: 2-month [[average]]
slides.note: Mar = (150 + 120) / 2 = **135**. Jan ko bahar kar diya ✂️

slides.title: [[Size]] badlo
points: Shuru ki rows mein **kam** values ka avg
slides.note: N ka avg = **N-1 PRECEDING** + CURRENT ROW 🎯

slides.right:
AVG(amount) OVER
  (ORDER BY month_no
   ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING
   AND CURRENT ROW)
slides.why: Frame nahi = default **shuru se ab tak** → cumulative avg aa jaata 😵
